skills.name: bio-glow
skills.description: Inside the body, built in Three.js: glossy red cells drift down a glowing red vessel toward the camera, with fog for depth, a warm bloom, and clean white labels on thin leader lines. The camera travels down the vessel the whole time while one hero cell gets a label and a big glowing counter climbs.

Science visuals that travel inside a vessel
skills.style: Nafay, 3D — glossy red cells in a glowing vessel, fog depth, warm bloom

skills.name: Blueprint

skills.style: Hand-drawn blueprint — pale line work on blueprint blue, fine grid, dimension lines with arrowheads, dashed yellow reference line, mono callouts

skills.name: breakdown
skills.description: A 3D exploded-view animation for a reel: a phone floats on a dark studio backdrop and comes apart layer by layer, glass, screen, frame, board, battery and back, with each part getting a thin leader line and a label. Use for an exploded view, a what-is-inside teardown or a labelled 3D breakdown of a device.
best_use_cases: Exploded-view teardowns of a phone or device
What is inside explainers with labelled parts
skills.style: Artem — 3D exploded view, dark studio backdrop, leader lines and labels

skills.name: Breaking Desk
skills.description: An invented news-desk package over your footage: a LIVE bug with a channel name, a red BREAKING tab, a white headline bar that types itself, a scrolling ticker, a map inset with a pulsing dot, and a clock.
skills.style: Invented news-desk package — LIVE bug, red BREAKING tab, typing headline bar, scrolling ticker, map inset with pulsing dot

skills.name: Callout Kit
skills.description: Hand-drawn annotation tools over your footage: red marker circles that draw themselves, arrows with marker labels, a magnifier box that zooms into a detail with connector lines, a pixelate blur for anything private, and a pulsing spotlight.
best_use_cases: Pointing out details in a clip
skills.style: Hand-drawn red marker annotations over footage — self-drawing circles, arrows with labels, 2x zoom box, pixelate blur, spotlight

skills.name: cartoon-audio-short
skills.description: Flat 2D bean-head cartoon characters with plum outlines in a colourful 3D world with black ink outlines, painted textures, depth-of-field and gliding cameras. The output is a vertical 1080x1920 cartoon short at 30 fps, exactly as long as the voiceover, with music and SFX at half the voice level.
best_use_cases: Animated cartoon Shorts and story videos
Voiceover-driven shorts where the picture is timed to the voice
skills.style: Cartoon-audio-short — flat 2D bean-head characters in a colourful 3D world, ink outlines, painted textures

skills.name: chalk-talk
skills.description: A teacher at a long green slate: grainy chalk strokes that skip over the board's tooth, colored chalk for emphasis, dust falling from the stick as it writes, faint ghosts of old lessons, a wooden frame and a dusty chalk tray. One continuous lesson along the board, with the camera tracking to the next stretch of slate.
best_use_cases: Teacher-style lessons written on a board
Step-by-step explanations that build along a slate
skills.style: Nafay, Hand-Drawn — green slate, grainy chalk strokes, coloured chalk emphasis, dust

skills.name: chat-story
skills.description: A story told through an invented messaging app: a clean header with a gradient avatar and an online dot, teal bubbles for me and white bubbles for them, typing dots before every reply, timestamps, read receipts, and a fictional-story tag. Messages pop in one by one and the thread scrolls up as it fills.
best_use_cases: Suspenseful chat-thread Shorts with a punchline
Dialogue-driven stories in a messaging app
skills.style: Nafay, Shorts Format — invented messaging app, teal and white bubbles, typing dots

skills.name: clay-diorama
skills.description: A soft clay miniature world on a round base, built in Three.js: chunky rounded shapes, warm studio light, a slow orbiting camera and a tilt-shift blur, with cream cards explaining each beat. The diorama pops up piece by piece, then the camera orbits while the idea plays out on the little world.
best_use_cases: Showing a process play out on a tiny clay scene
skills.style: Nafay, 3D — soft clay miniature on a round base, warm studio light, tilt-shift blur

skills.name: Clean Tech
skills.description: A calm, bright product-explainer look: cool off-white with a drifting dot grid, crisp Inter Tight words that rise into place, white UI cards with soft shadows, one electric blue accent, mono labels and a green check for anything finished.
skills.style: Kinetic type on cool off-white: short statements rise word by word, the key word gets a blue pill, and ideas become small working diagrams — a prompt card that types and sends, nodes that pop in, a dot that travels a loop, task rows that tick off, a counter that climbs.

skills.name: Comic Panels
skills.description: A comic-book page drawn in code: thick black panel borders, halftone dot fills in bright flat colours, round speech balloons, yellow caption boxes, and a big spiky sound-effect burst, with Bangers lettering throughout.
best_use_cases: Explainers with speech balloons and captions
Big-moment reveals with a sound-effect burst
skills.style: Illustrated comic page: the camera reads the page like a reader, zooming into one panel at a time in reading order, shaking on the big sound effect, then pulling out to show the whole page with the title panel.

skills.name: Cosmic Scale
skills.description: Planets and stars at their true relative sizes in a deep starfield, built in Three.js with textures painted in code, and a camera that pulls back in big log-scale moves to reveal the scale.
best_use_cases: Showing how big things really are
skills.style: 3D in Three.js: every body uses its true radius relative to the others, surfaces painted in code, the camera moves on a log scale so each pull-back feels like the same size of jump, with thin labels carrying the real size.

skills.name: Creator Motion Graphics
skills.description: High-energy business/creator explainers; punchy claims, numbers, proof mockups. Huge condensed caps slam in word by word, a yellow serif accent marks the one word that matters, highlighter swipes, hand-drawn circles and arrows, tilted browser and phone mockups, rolling green counters, film grain and light leaks on near-black.
skills.style: Kinetic type on near-black: Anton caps slam in word by word, one yellow serif word per line, green only for money and growth numbers, red only for the wrong idea, whip pans, RGB glitches and flash cuts between ideas.

skills.name: Crosshatch
skills.description: A sketchy ink line that boils on 2s, crosshatch and coloured-pencil shading clipped inside shapes, stipple, paper grain. Warm cream paper and wood by day; navy inside-the-computer worlds with periwinkle lines and glowing accents.
best_use_cases: Sketchy ink explainers with a plan-then-do structure
skills.style: Hand-drawn ink: wobbly strokes reseeded every boil step, textures clipped inside shapes, light shaded with a density function, the hero terracotta dot in both worlds, red pencil dashes for the plan.

skills.name: Cut Paper
skills.description: Torn-edge paper shapes with soft drop shadows, paper grain and crayon in the fills, patterns (stripes, dots, gingham, wood grain), full-bleed colour worlds, and characters with simple faces. Collage-style animation: playful, warm, busy with small life.
skills.style: Cut-paper collage: every shape is torn paper with a wobbly edge, soft shadow and grain; one dominant wall colour per scene, pops for arrivals, hand-lettered text on paper tags, the spark's ray count telling time.

skills.name: dan-koe
skills.description: Dan Koe style minimal black-and-white line art for a reel: one white dot on pure black grows into a hairline tree that splits in two at every step, the tips light up, a pulse ring and sparks go off, and one quiet lowercase line swaps to a second. Use for calm black-and-white motion graphics about choices, habits or compounding.
best_use_cases: Calm black-and-white motion graphics about choices and habits
Minimal line-art reels with one moving dot
skills.style: Artem — minimal black-and-white line art, hairline branching tree, one white dot

skills.name: Data City
skills.description: A 3D bar chart that grows like a city skyline at night, built in Three.js: navy towers with lit windows, glowing cyan-to-magenta roofs, a grid floor fading into fog, and values floating above each tower.
best_use_cases: Making numbers feel like a city
skills.style: 3D in Three.js: tower heights exactly proportional to the values, a slow orbit around the skyline, the tallest tower gets a light beam and a callout, then the camera rises over the city for the takeaway number.

skills.name: Data Story
skills.description: Numbers, trends, comparisons — anything where the data IS the story. A calm, editorial data explainer: deep ink background, one warm accent per idea, Archivo headlines, IBM Plex Mono numbers and labels, charts that draw themselves to scale, and the source always on screen.
best_use_cases: Data-driven explainers with sources on screen
skills.style: Editorial data explainer: lines draw left to right with a glowing head, bars grow one by one with counting values, comparison cards with a sand multiplier, and a plain-language takeaway with a sand pill behind the key phrase.

skills.name: Deep Layers
skills.description: A cross-section block of the ground in Three.js, with a tiny house and trees on top and stacked layers of soil, clay, rock and glowing hot rock below. A white drill line pushes down while the camera dives with it.
best_use_cases: Layered earth, drilling and depth explainers
skills.style: 3D cross-section: stacked Three.js boxes in believable material colours (grass green, soil brown, sand, grey rock, dark granite, glowing orange heat), a small surface scene on top, a thin white drill with a glowing yellow tip, dark mono layer labels with real depths, Anton headlines with a yellow second line.

skills.name: deep-dive
skills.description: Real stylized 3D explainers rendered in three.js: sculpted people in warm sunlit sets, glowing x-ray cutaways and camera journeys through blood vessels, with shallow focus and a camera that never stops moving. Curious, shocking and satisfying.
best_use_cases: What happens if...? explainers about the human body
Showing what happens inside the body with x-ray cutaways
skills.style: Faceless-shorts — real 3D three.js, warm sunlit sets, cyan x-ray cutaways, deep-red macro body interiors

skills.name: Doc Cinema
skills.description: Mini-documentary finishing: letterbox bars, heavy film grain, a warm-cool grade, slow Ken Burns push-ins, big serif chapter titles centred in the frame, and a small mono location and date stamp in the corner.
best_use_cases: Cinematic finishing over footage or stills
skills.style: Edit overlay: letterbox bars, heavy stepped film grain, vignette and warm-highlight / cool-shadow grade, slow 4-8% push-ins, tracked chapter labels with centred Instrument Serif titles, mono location stamps typed in.

skills.name: evidence-board
skills.description: A detective corkboard: speckled cork, polaroids with sketched clues, typed index cards, yellow sticky notes, red push pins and red string, with a case-file label taped at the top and a rubber stamp for the verdict. The camera moves across the board clue by clue as red string draws itself from pin to pin.
skills.style: Nafay, Illustrated — detective corkboard, polaroids, red string, verdict stamp

skills.name: Exploded View

skills.style: 3D studio teardown: light grey background, shadow-only floor, soft key light, slow turntable, parts lifting apart one at a time with even gaps, Space Grotesk headlines, numbered JetBrains Mono labels on self-drawing leader lines, one part glowing to show why it matters.

skills.name: Glass Icons
skills.description: Glossy translucent 3D app icons in Three.js, floating on a soft mint, sky and peach gradient, each with a white symbol on its face, frosted labels and a crisp black headline.

skills.style: 3D glossy icons: rounded squares with bevel, clearcoat and slight transparency in soft colours, white 3D symbols on the face, mint-sky-peach gradient background, frosted info cards with mono number and one-line benefit, Inter 900 headlines.

skills.name: glitch-pack
skills.description: A digital-glitch toolkit: RGB-split titles in Anton, horizontal slice displacement, block noise in red and cyan, scanlines, a SYSTEM REBOOT terminal tag and glitch transitions that tear your footage apart and put it back together. The intro title glitches on and resolves crisp.

skills.name: globe-arcs

The globe turns into view, a pin drops at the start, then each route arcs up off the surface and lands on its destination.

skills.style: Nafay, 3D — navy dot globe in a starfield, amber route arcs, atmosphere glow

skills.name: graph

Time passing in a single location

skills.name: Pixel
skills.description: Pixel art. Every picture is drawn at a low internal resolution - 90x160, 135x240, 180x320 for a 9:16 frame - with whole-pixel primitives in a limited palette, then scaled up nearest-neighbour to 1080x1920. Hard square pixels, ordered (Bayer) dithering instead of gradients, a built-in 5x7 bitmap font, sprites from string arrays, and screen effects that belong to a device: an LCD grid for a handheld, scanlines and a curved-tube vignette for an arcade.
best_use_cases: Stories told across eras, with resolution marking time
Chronologies that get sharper as they go

skills.description: A polished screen-recording tutorial built entirely in code: an app window on a soft gradient desktop, a real-feeling cursor with click ripples, a camera that zooms into what matters, yellow-edged spotlights, numbered step callouts and a calm pad underneath.
skills.name: software-walkthrough
skills.style: App window on a soft gradient desktop, real-feeling cursor with click ripples, zooming camera, yellow-edged spotlights, numbered step callouts

skills.description: The retention split: your clip on the top half, a satisfying loop drawn in code on the bottom half (kinetic sand being sliced into rainbow layers), and a white caption bar in the seam that carries the story line by line.

skills.name: stick-figure
skills.description: A code-animated stick-figure explainer reel, 9:16 and 30 to 45 seconds, from a question or topic: a bright cartoon world with thick outlines, stick people with big white heads and faces, constant camera motion, whip transitions, 1 to 2 word captions and cartoon sound effects, all timed to the voiceover word by word.
best_use_cases: Playful explainer Shorts timed to the voiceover
skills.style: Artem — stick figures with big white heads, bright cartoon world, thick outlines, whip cuts

skills.name: stick-story
skills.description: Black stick people whose big white eyes do the acting, in flat illustrated rooms in day and night versions, with gold numbered step cards and one picture per clause. Tense, clever and a little funny.

Practical safety advice in clear numbered steps
Scenario explainers with a light, funny tone

skills.description: A cosy scrapbook layer over your vlog: die-cut stickers with thick white borders (a title pill, stars, hearts, a coffee cup), striped washi tape on the corners and a lined paper note with handwriting, all popping in with a wobble.
skills.name: sticker-pop
skills.style: Cosy scrapbook: die-cut stickers with thick white borders, striped washi tape, lined paper note with handwriting, pop-in wobble

skills.description: Gentle narrative/fable-like stories, one moment per page; vertical Shorts.
skills.name: storybook
skills.style: Painted storybook pages, one moment per page, gentle watercolour hills and night sky

skills.name: Swiss Grid
skills.description: International Typographic Style in motion: a strict six-column grid, one huge number, solid red, black and blue geometric blocks, flush-left Inter in black, and small caps labels, all snapping into place with precise wipes. Blocks wipe in along the grid, the big number counts up digit by digit, and the statement snaps in line by line; halfway through, the composition re-arranges on the grid to introduce a second point, then settles on a one-line takeaway.
best_use_cases: Presenting a single striking fact or number
Data-led explainers where the number is the story
skills.style: Strict six-column grid; huge Archivo Black number counting up digit by digit; red (#e1251b) and blue (#1f4fd8) blocks with black type on off-white; flush-left Inter statements; precise wipe and mask-reveal motion; source line in small type at the bottom.

skills.name: synth-grid
skills.description: A retro neon world: a magenta wireframe landscape scrolling toward you in Three.js under a striped sunset sun, purple sky, chrome-gradient titles with a pink glow and a cyan marker script. The grid races toward the camera the whole time.
skills.style: Nafay, 3D — magenta wireframe landscape, striped sunset sun, chrome titles, purple sky

skills.name: Tactics Board
skills.description: A top-down pitch with mown stripes and crisp white lines, red and blue numbered player tokens with soft shadows, dashed run arrows that draw themselves, a yellow ball path with numbered passes, and a running clock chip. Players move between real positions as a counter-attack unfolds pass by pass, defenders shift, the clock counts the seconds, and the finish gets a flash and a big word, then the takeaway.
best_use_cases: Explaining a sports play pass by pass
Showing movement and positioning on a pitch
Data-driven match analysis in a Short
skills.style: Top-down pitch in real proportions with mown stripes and crisp white lines; red and blue numbered player tokens; dashed run arrows that draw themselves; yellow numbered ball path; running clock chip; Anton headline type.

skills.name: tall-tale
skills.description: Flat 2D cartoon people with thick ink outlines, big round white heads and bean bodies acting inside a sunny, saturated 3D world of small-town streets, shops, meadows and trains. Playful, clever and a little cheeky, with the camera moving in every shot.
best_use_cases: Light-hearted documented anecdotes with expressive characters
Playful cartoon Shorts with word-by-word captions
skills.style: Faceless-shorts — flat 2D toon people in a sunny saturated 3D world, thick ink outlines

skills.name: Terminal
skills.description: A glowing green-on-black terminal: typed commands with a block cursor, dim grey output, red and amber warnings, an ASCII progress bar and ASCII box diagrams, with scanlines, a soft phosphor glow and a dark vignette. The story is a terminal session: a command types itself, output scrolls out line by line, a progress bar runs, and the result lands in red or amber; a second command shows the contrast, and an ASCII comparison box sums it up.
best_use_cases: Explaining a technical idea as a terminal session
Showing a before-and-after comparison in ASCII
skills.style: Glowing green-on-black terminal; typed commands with block cursor; dim grey output; red and amber warnings; ASCII progress bar and box diagrams; scanlines, phosphor glow, dark vignette.

skills.name: tier-list
skills.description: A classic tier-list board on dark charcoal: S to D rows with bright rainbow labels, rounded item tiles with simple icons drawn in code, and a stash of unranked tiles at the bottom that fly up one by one. Each item leaves the stash, hangs for a moment with its name, then arcs into its tier.
best_use_cases: Ranking items from S to D
Opinion and debate videos with a board
skills.style: Nafay, Shorts Format — dark charcoal tier board, S to D rainbow rows, flying item tiles

skills.name: timeline-rail
skills.description: A deep green page with a cream vertical rail: glowing year nodes, cream event cards with a big gold year and a small drawn icon, and a running year odometer in the corner, as the camera scrolls down through time. As it reaches each year the node lights up and the card drops in.
best_use_cases: History told year by year down a rail
skills.style: Nafay, Data — deep green page, cream vertical rail, glowing year nodes, odometer

skills.name: top-5-countdown
skills.description: A countdown Short on deep navy: a huge outlined rank number slams in beside an illustrated card drawn in code, with the name in tall Anton caps, a mono detail line, and a ladder of rank dots on the side that tracks where you are. Each rank gets its own beat, and number one gets a bigger hit and a glow.
best_use_cases: Ranked lists with a punch per rank
skills.style: Nafay, Shorts Format — deep navy countdown, huge outlined rank number, Anton caps

skills.name: Versus Split
skills.description: A head-to-head Short: the screen splits diagonally into coral and blue halves that slam in from the sides, a black VS badge with a yellow ring, two characters drawn in code, and stat bars that race toward each other row by row with a winner crown.
best_use_cases: Stat-by-stat battles with a running score
skills.style: Diagonal coral (#ff6b4a) vs blue (#2b6cff) split, black VS badge with yellow ring, big white Anton names, dark stat panel with bars racing out from the centre, counting values and a yellow crown on the winner. Fight-night beat, slams, counter ticks and a crowd cheer for the verdict.

skills.name: VHS Camcorder
skills.description: A home-video camcorder overlay on your footage: a blocky white PLAY or REC readout, a blinking red dot, a battery icon, a date and time stamp, a tracking-noise band that rolls through, chroma bleed, a warm faded grade and scanlines.
best_use_cases: Home-video looks over your own footage
skills.style: Warm faded grade with red/cyan chroma bleed and scanlines, VT323 on-screen display (PLAY/REC/REW, battery, date, running clock), a rolling tracking band with a horizontal tear, and a REW rewind with streaks and a backwards clock. Tape hiss and motor hum underneath.

skills.name: Visual Novel
skills.description: A visual-novel scene: a soft, blurred painted background, a large original anime-style character bust drawn in code with big glossy eyes, swapping expressions, and a translucent dialogue box with a name tag and typewriter text.
skills.style: Original code-drawn anime bust (layered hair with shine, big eyes with highlights, blush) on a soft blurred painted background; dark translucent dialogue box with pink border and name tag, text typed at ~28 characters a second, expression effects (sweat, sparkles, shock lines), ending on a two-option choice menu. M PLUS Rounded 1c throughout.

skills.name: Warm Canvas
skills.description: A calm, editorial creator edit built around your own footage: full-frame talking head with a few clean serif captions, then a warm off-white canvas with a soft swoosh where white cards explain the idea while you shrink into a rounded picture-in-picture.
skills.style: Two modes only: full-frame A-roll with one centred Fraunces caption (key words in sky blue #4f9cf0) and small side chips, or the warm canvas (#f7f5f4 with one big swoosh) with the speaker in a rounded 272x384 PiP and the content in the left column. White cards, radius 20, pastel tags, gentle fades and soft counters, never a bounce. Quiet tactile sound: paper slides, wooden taps, one warm pad.

skills.name: Woodcut Tale
skills.description: A two-colour woodcut print come to life: cream paper, bold black ink shapes with white carved hatching inside them, a red second colour slightly out of register, ink speckle and paper grain, with old-style serif captions in a carved border.
skills.style: Two inks only (black #1a1410, red #b8322a) on cream paper, red layer 3 px out of register, carved hatching inside every inked shape, stiff 8 fps flipbook motion with a tiny jitter, paper-wipe scene changes, IM Fell English captions in a carved double-line border, the moral printed in red small caps.

skills.name: zach-d-films
skills.description: A 3D cartoon what-if explainer short in the style of Zack D. Films-type videos, entirely in code with three.js: procedural cartoon people, props and effects, a blue studio sky, slow-motion impacts, a red force-ripple overlay, quick whip cuts and 1 to 3 word captions timed to the voiceover.
best_use_cases: Could X stop Y style shorts with characters and props
skills.style: Artem — 3D cartoon, three.js, blue studio sky, slow-motion impacts, red force ripple

skills.name: Zine Collage
skills.description: A DIY zine on kraft paper: torn pink and black paper, halftone cutouts drawn in code, ransom-note letters each in a different font and colour, translucent tape strips and handwritten notes, all slapped on at a jittery 8 frames a second.
skills.style: Kraft paper (#e2d2b2) with speckles, torn jagged shapes in hot pink, black, white and yellow with short drop shadows, halftone dot-grid subjects, ransom-note titles with each letter in its own font/colour box, tape strips, Caveat handwriting, stop-motion 8 fps slap timing with 1-2 px jitter. Lo-fi beat with vinyl crackle.
